name: fighorse
description: Figma data Swiss Army knife, shaped for AI consumption

scripts.package:darwin-x64: bun run build && bun run compile && rm -f dist/fighorse-darwin-x64.tar.gz && tar -C dist -czf dist/fighorse-darwin-x64.tar.gz fighorse
scripts.package:darwin-arm64: bun run build && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 dist/fighorse.js --outfile dist/fighorse-darwin-arm64 && rm -f dist/fighorse-darwin-arm64.tar.gz && tar -C dist -czf dist/fighorse-darwin-arm64.tar.gz fighorse-darwin-arm64
scripts.package:macos: bun run package:darwin-x64 && bun run package:darwin-arm64
scripts.install:local: bun run build && bun run compile && ./dist/fighorse install --default --apply --source ./dist/fighorse
scripts.test:integration: shadow-cljs compile test && FIGMA_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true bun target/test.js
scripts.check: bun run test && bun run build && bun run compile
